items.title: Sandisk And 2 Cash Flow Stocks To Watch
items.summary: China plans to spend about US$940b on energy transition in 2026, with heavy investment in grids and low carbon power. That much long term capital searching for reliable returns can highlight businesses that quietly generate cash yet still trade cheaply. This article looks at three such stocks identified by our cash flow based value screen and explains why patient investors are watching them closely now.
